title: Vannilla+Reborned
body:
## Welcome to the ultimate Vanilla+ experience!
This modpack is carefuly **Crafted** for **vanilla lovers** who want to expand their world without losing that classic minecraft feeling.
## ✨ Key Features:
Advanced Mechanics: Dive into automation and beautiful engineering with **Create**. 
 Immersive Audio: Customize music with **Etched**.  
Better food:  Cook some noodles with meat, or are you craving something different? How about  some spiced chicken, or perhaps you're looking for new ingredients for your farm? You can do  this with **Farmers Delight**. 
## There's a lot more 
So start your story here
